title: Foundry Artifact Manifest v1
description: A collection of ArtifactRecord entries (see artifact-record.schema.json) — the Foundry-level manifest, distinct from specs/alchemist/v1/artifact-manifest.schema.json (a single per-compilation-result field). No unified manifest of this shape is returned by any current endpoint; this is the target aggregate shape. See docs/bible/09-foundry/201-artifact-manifest-model.md.
